# Project status and evidence

<!-- BEGIN status-summary: generated by scripts/generate_status.py; edit docs/status-data.json and docs/evidence/ -->
Documentation review: 2026-11-07. This page summarizes the evidence
committed to this repository. The review date is not a device-test date.

Recorded replay and bounded mirror recognition have Frame results. The
continuous live HUD still needs device acceptance; dedicated camera capture
is paused. See [current work](live-capture.md#current-work-order) for the next
steps and pending reports, or the [evidence catalog](evidence/README.md#catalog)
to inspect a result.

## Capability matrix

Each row separates what was demonstrated from what remains unverified.
Cloud tests, CI, user reports and physical headset recovery are different
kinds of evidence. Unknown dates, revisions and runtime versions stay unknown.

### Active POC

| Capability | State | Evidence and limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Continuous live input in the Qt/VR application | Offline fixed edge HUD only; production closed | Mirror includes our panel; the fixed edge HUD requires qualified full-footprint native masking plus feedback/expiry acceptance; [E18](#e18-vr-panel-included-in-mirror-input), [E69](#e69-offline-edge-hud-and-native-mask-validation) |
| Fixed edge HUD, marker and offline live pipeline | Offline validation passed; G2 closed; G3 open | The owner accepted rehearsed recovery; the green-input cause is unknown ([E79](#e79-g2-green-input-log-analysis-and-recovery-rehearsal-on-frame)). G3 stopped before any marker ([E83](#e83-g3-marker-observer-attempt-stopped-at-the-observer-scene-precondition)). Production gates stay closed; [implementation and limits](evidence/capability-notes.md#fixed-edge-hud-marker-and-offline-live-pipeline). |
| Bounded mirror recognition | Rewritten path re-run on Frame; broader accuracy open | The November 3 rerun had labels matching the owner’s view ([E81](#e81-catch-up-session-on-frame-regressions-400-frame-panel-run-mirror-and-wp2-stills)). [Earlier measurements, still export and limits](evidence/capability-notes.md#bounded-mirror-recognition). |
| Existing-mirror diagnostic | Frame capture confirmed; VR panel included in input | Physical-room preview and bounded inference work, but this composited view includes our overlay; physical camera identity/timing remain unknown; [E14](#e14-physical-room-visible-in-the-mirror-preview), [E18](#e18-vr-panel-included-in-mirror-input) |
| Recognition on the saved room still | Frame execution confirmed; false positive | One image processed and annotated; user identifies the `sofa`-labeled item as a rug; [E15](#e15-saved-room-recognition-and-rug-false-positive) |
| Candidate detector and evaluation harness | E61 miss reproduced; Frame model choice open | The original still and digest were verified on Frame; the miss remains unexplained ([E80](#e80-file-only-detector-re-run-on-the-e61-still-with-audit-variants)). Five unboxed stills support the chair demo, not a model default. [Evaluation details](evidence/capability-notes.md#candidate-detector-and-evaluation-harness). |

### Replay and development

The review's cycle-3 follow-ups (glob guard, update signal handling and outcome, lock-file and checkout-state reporting, installer cleanup) are fixed, cloud-checked and merged ([E84](#e84-ship-pass-of-2026-11-06-cloud-checks-for-prs-22-24-25-26-and-27)); none has run on Frame. ### Paused provider research

| Capability | State | Evidence and limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Public OpenVR tracked-camera probe | Device-confirmed failure | No frames and observed passthrough interruption; do not repeat the unchanged test; [E3](#e3-public-camera-probe) |
| Dedicated-camera shared-memory reader | Controlled x86_64 and Frame ARM64 tests passed | All 14 reader/supervisor tests pass on Frame; actual provider and upstream writer ordering remain unverified; [E23](#e23-reference-build-and-controlled-reader-on-frame) |
| Native capture prerequisite report | Frame report received | aarch64 SteamOS 0.5.6, GCC 15.1.1 and Vulkan 1.4.309 development metadata/headers; no capture configuration at checked paths; [E21](#e21-capture-prerequisites-on-frame) |
| Pinned capture reference build | Cloud and Frame ARM64 compile/link checks passed | Unmodified upstream inspection artifacts only; no activation, runtime fixes still required; [E23](#e23-reference-build-and-controlled-reader-on-frame) |
| Descriptor transport adaptation | Controlled cloud and Frame ARM64 checks passed | Adapted components compile/link on Frame and fixture reports seven groups passed; live callbacks and remaining provider work unverified; [E25](#e25-descriptor-transport-on-frame) |
| Provider publication and loop controls | Controlled cloud and Frame tests passed | Exclusive private runtime file, ordered writer and bounded loop controls; all eight generated-data process tests passed on Frame; full GPU/provider lifecycle pending; [E27](#e27-publication-and-loop-controls-on-frame) |
| Bounded Vulkan capability query | Frame-confirmed; queried requirements passed | Turnip Adreno 750, target NV12 modifier has two memory planes, dedicated DMA-BUF import supported; clean query and normal passthrough; no actual FD import; [E30](#e30-vulkan-capabilities-on-frame) |
| Image import validation and ownership | ARM64 build and ten synthetic tests passed; cloud suite now eleven | FD/image ownership and failure paths validated with fake dispatch; added two-plane case cloud-only; real GPU import remains untested; [E31](#e31-import-build-and-synthetic-tests-on-frame), [E32](#e32-two-plane-import-fixture-cloud-checks) |
| Device and remaining GPU resource ownership | Inspection adaptation built; nine synthetic cloud tests passed | Startup/child lifetimes, private allocations, imported-image device retention and 57 injected failures; actual driver and ARM64 execution pending; [E33](#e33-gpu-resource-ownership-cloud-checks) |
| Capture watchdog, provider/layer lifecycle and exact recovery | Earlier synthetic Frame checks passed; later fixes cloud-only | The v2 milestone passed 28 generated-data tests on Frame. Driver execution and physical recovery remain unverified. [Lifecycle and November 4 fix details](evidence/capability-notes.md#capture-watchdog-providerlayer-lifecycle-and-exact-recovery). |
| Metadata-only provider and producer synchronization review | Metadata-only checks passed; image access blocked | The v3 build and 24 generated-data tests passed on Frame. E65 separately records actual metadata loading/restoration. [Scope and limits](evidence/capability-notes.md#metadata-only-provider-and-producer-synchronization-review). |
| Inactive v3 bundle and SteamVR service preflight | Frame report received | Bundle prepared without activation; active simple/control-group user service, 20-second stop timeout, no drop-ins; [E38](#e38-inactive-bundle-and-steamvr-service-on-frame) |
| Bounded metadata-layer trial and post-exit recovery | Metadata loading/restoration reported; inspection unstable | Two trials found eight stable candidate records, but the full registry did not settle. Image access stays blocked. [Session sequence and evidence](evidence/capability-notes.md#bounded-metadata-layer-trial-and-post-exit-recovery). |
| Dedicated Arcturus Vulkan capture | Upstream-reported | Community implementation reviewed; no SightCircuit deployment or device capture result |
| Built-in passthrough camera input | Unverified | Upstream reports empty built-in-camera-sized buffers; no source-identified built-in-camera frames have been received |

### Deferred

| Capability | State | Evidence and limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stereo depth and world-space labels | Deferred | Calibration, depth and pose/timebase alignment remain unresolved |
| Gaussian splat reconstruction and viewing | Deferred optional work | Recorded-data workflow researched; training and headset splat rendering not validated by this project |

Process reaping and successful API cleanup do not
establish physical headset recovery. Production live HUD gates remain closed.

## Maintaining the evidence

The coordinator checks pending allocations before assigning an evidence ID and adds its record
and metadata to `docs/evidence/index.json`. Record execution date, platform,
runtime, revision, procedure, observations and limits; mark unavailable fields
unknown. Update reviewed capabilities in `docs/status-data.json`, then run:

```bash
python3 scripts/generate_status.py
python3 scripts/generate_status.py --check
```

The generator updates this file, the evidence catalog and the marked architecture progress block.
[Live capture](live-capture.md) owns next tasks; the
[documentation plan](documentation-plan.md) owns maintenance conventions.
